infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pocket Planter uses your photo library to let you add progress photos to your garden journal. For example, you can document how your tomato plant grows over time.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Pocket Planter uses your camera to capture garden photos for your journal.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Pocket Planter uses your location to automatically detect your ZIP code and growing zone.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Pocket Planter uses Face ID to let you sign in quickly and securely with your face.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Pocket Planter adds your planting and harvest reminders to your calendar so you never miss a sow or harvest window.
